text:
ashley: Hey team — opened a docs PR for the dedicated deployment guide, need a quick reviewer + can we target a merge before tomorrow's release window? https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4824 :wave:
devon: I can review but heads up — watch the tone section, we should avoid marketing phrases like "best-in-class". keep it pragmatic and neutral. :+1:
linus: CI preview is failing on that PR, looks like a broken internal link to /sdk/python/migration#kv-cache. ci-bot posted an error earlier. hold on merge until that is fixed.
ci-bot: preview build failed for PR #4824 — error: anchor "sdk-snippet-kv-cache" not found in /sdk/python/migration. logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/3456 
mica: also a quick terminology nit: our style guide prefers "model variant" when referring to runtime fallbacks, and "model version" for pinned model artifacts. this doc mixes them. recommend a sweep.
docs-bot: lint warning: sentence-case headings required. File: docs/dedicated/deploy.md line 42 — uses Title Case. Also: prefer code fenced examples for SDK snippets.
sam: I can fix the link and run the preview again, but question on snippet — migration example currently uses older python API. Should we use the new unified client snippet?
ashley: yes, use the unified client. swap old usage to the modern snippet and add a one-line explanation about pinning model versions for Dedicated. keep it short.
sam: putting a draft patch in the thread:```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient()
# old: client.generate(...)
# new: client.text.generate(model="redwood-alpha-1", input="Translate...", max_tokens=64)
```
sam: also swapped term "fallback model" -> "model variant" and fixed the anchor id to `sdk-snippet-kv-cache`.
devon: nice. couple tone nits: replace "you can easily" with "to reduce latency," and avoid second-person in the config explanation.
linus: re-run preview? ci-bot should pick up the updated anchor.
ci-bot: queued preview rebuild for PR #4824 — triggered by sam. Status: running. logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/3457
ci-bot: preview build succeeded for PR #4824 — no broken anchors. website changes available at https://deploy-preview-4824.redwood.ai
docs-bot: docs-lint: terminology warnings cleared. remaining: add a short migration note about KV cache invalidation when upgrading model revisions.
ashley: ok assign reviewers: @devon for voice/style, @mica for terminology, @linus for link/preview. If all green we'll merge after the 2pm deploy freeze lifts (2:15pm).
devon: reviewing now, will leave inline comments for a couple phrasing tweaks.
mica: reviewing terminology pass. small nit: prefer "cache key" over "KV key" in user-facing docs.
linus: link/preview check done, looks good.
ashley: thanks all. plan: i'll wait for devon+mica signoffs then merge at ~2:20pm. leaving this open until then. :clock2:
devon: approved. :white_check_mark:
mica: approved after tiny wording changes. :white_check_mark:
ashley: merged PR #4824 at 1959754967 — thanks everyone. closing thread.
